summary: Independent verification of Locat Media Hub (Milestone A+B). Ran existing pytest suite (23/23 PASS) covering health, libraries, cinema scan+decision engine, HTTP 206 range streaming (full/suffix/invalid), music metadata/favorites/stream, honest bit-perfect reporting, dual audio mode switch persistence, and EQ preset CRUD. Smoke-tested all /api/media endpoints via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — health returns runtime=web, 2 sample libraries auto-seeded with ffprobe/mutagen metadata. Playwright-tested all 5 frontend routes (/, /cinema, /cinema/{id}, /music, /music/eq, /integration) — every required data-testid present and interactive: hub-home/health-card/library-grid, cinema-library + 2 cinema-card-*, cinema-player + player-video + player-diagnostics + path-chip-direct-play, music-library + album-play-* populating music-player-bar, mode-pure-audio/mode-enhanced-dsp toggling eq-disabled-notice, all 10 eq-band-0..9 sliders, bit-perfect chip reads 'UNAVAILABLE', and all 4 adapter cards on /integration. Diagnostics panel renders live ffprobe values (1280x720, h264, aac, 6.38 Mbps, HTTP 206 partial content).

issues: A stale library card for root_path '/etc' is listed (status=idle, 0 items). It appears to be residue from a prior test run that successfully created the DB row before the authorized-roots guard was tightened, or persists because rejection happens elsewhere. The POST /api/media/libraries guard currently works (pytest test_reject_unauthorized_root passes with 403), so this is leftover data — recommend adding a startup cleanup that drops libraries whose root_path is no longer in LOCAT_MEDIA_AUTHORIZED_ROOTS.
Console warning: deprecated CSS 'appearance: slider-vertical' used on EQ band sliders — switch to `writing-mode: vertical-lr; direction: rtl` as Chromium recommends. Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional) Add a one-shot cleanup on router startup to delete library rows whose root_path isn't in LOCAT_MEDIA_AUTHORIZED_ROOTS, so the stale '/etc' entry doesn't surface in the Hub grid.
(Optional) Replace deprecated 'slider-vertical' CSS appearance on EQ sliders.
critical_code_review_comments: Mock adapters are clearly flagged in /app/packages/locat-media-adapters/* — must be swapped for real Locat identity/device/host in production. Already called out in review request.

Headless Chromium cannot decode H.264 (known Playwright codec limitation) — <video> renders a 'no supported sources' banner but Direct Play chip + diagnostics still correct. Confirmed not a product bug.

Bit-perfect honesty guard is working: /api/media/music/audio-mode?runtime=web returns bit_perfect=unavailable regardless of active mode, and NEVER returns 'verified' from web runtime (asserted by pytest test_pure_audio_never_reports_verified_from_web).
test_credentials: No credentials required (LOCAT_DEV_MODE=true). For auth-required mode: Authorization: Bearer locat-dev-token.
seed_data_creation: None added by this run. Backend auto-seeds 2 sample libraries on startup from /app/media_samples/.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 23 pytest cases in /app/tests/test_media_hub.py pass. Frontend data-testids are stable: hub-home, hub-health-card, hub-library-grid, cinema-library, cinema-card-*, cinema-player, player-video, player-diagnostics, path-chip-*, music-library, album-play-*, music-player-bar, mode-pure-audio, mode-enhanced-dsp, eq-bands, eq-band-0..9, eq-disabled-notice, adapter-{Auth,Storage,DevicePairing,Host}Adapter. The only visible leftover is a stale '/etc' library on the Hub grid — purely cosmetic, backend guard works.
